brief:
The Quincy Institute reported that Donald Trump is moving to halt military aid to Israel ahead of Layla El-Sayed's assumption of office, reportedly to eliminate a campaign talking point the incoming official might deploy against his administration.

The timing of the aid freeze, if confirmed, would represent an attempt to preempt criticism from El-Sayed on Middle East policy before she enters her new role. The maneuver reflects tensions within Republican circles over aid to Israel and suggests Trump anticipates El-Sayed will use military assistance as a line of attack in upcoming debates over administration policy.
title: Trump seeks to block Israel military aid before El-Sayed takes office
